ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Monotype: Media and Methods for Painterly Printmaking. Students will practice additive and subtractive methods of image development using oil and water based pigments on various plate types including copper and polyester. Assignments will be based on the working methods of a variety of historical practitioners of monotype printmaking as well as contemporary examples. No prior artistic experience is required. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course. $95 Facility Charge.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
